description_sq:
Ofrohet per shitje apartament ne Selite, prane Universitetit Barleti.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e pare te nje pallati te mireadministruar.
Organizohet ne sallon plus kuzhinen, dy dhoma gjumi, tualet edhe ballkon.
description_en: Apartment for sale in Selite, near Barleti University. The apartment is located on the first floor of a well-managed building. It is organized in the living room plus kitchen, two bedrooms, bathroom and balcony.
